build_lightfield_model: build a LightfieldModel from a config to embed rays and predict colors via the color model
create_base_color_model: create a BaseColorModel MLP that maps input channels to color output channels using a net config
embed_rays_with_lightfield: embed input rays through the LightfieldModel param and embedding model to get feature representations
set_iteration_on_model: set the current training iteration on a LightfieldModel and all its submodels and embeddings
register_model_in_dict: register a LightfieldModel class in the ray_model_dict, pos_model_dict, and model_dict registries
